threads.preview:

Quick checklist before you touch a bar

paragraphs: Look, you said you were going to get back on the board with a lift, and you got 23 minutes in yesterday morning. It breaks the dry spell. Let me know what you actually hit in that session, what the RPE was, and if we're still locking in another lift this weekend.

messages.text: That was just morning foundation coach

messages.text: I will do it today coach!

paragraphs:
That is what I want to hear. Lock it in.

Quick checklist before you touch a bar:
1. Single-leg glute bridge on the right in the warm-up. Squeeze before extending.
2. Front lever protocol: SL FL benchmark tested LEFT first, then straddle negatives (25kg band, 5x3 controlled), then SL holds (15kg band, 3x10s).
3. Dips stay at bodyweight with that 3-second eccentric.

Keep it clean, get your numbers down, and tell me how it felt when you're done.

input.message: Can you build me a full-body strength routine, no equipment, for twice a week?

output.reply:
Look, when you have zero equipment, tempo and intent do all the work. You don't need a rack to build real tension.

I built you 'Travel Full Body' in your routines. It's dialed for twice a week:
- **Warm-up:** Single-leg glute bridge first. We do not skip the right hip activation. Squeeze and own the top before you stand up.
- **Upper:** Clean push-ups and pike push-ups. Control the descent.
- **Lower:** Split squats and bodyweight single-leg RDLs. Take three seconds on the way down on the split squats. Make bodyweight feel heavy.
- **Core:** Solid, active plank to wrap it up.

Run it twice a week, 48 hours apart. Take every rep with clean focus. Let me know how the first run feels.

messages.text: Can you build me a full-body strength routine, no equipment, for twice a week?

paragraphs:
Look, when you have zero equipment, tempo and intent do all the work. You don't need a rack to build real tension.

I built you 'Travel Full Body' in your routines. It's dialed for twice a week:
- **Warm-up:** Single-leg glute bridge first. We do not skip the right hip activation. Squeeze and own the top before you stand up.
- **Upper:** Clean push-ups and pike push-ups. Control the descent.
- **Lower:** Split squats and bodyweight single-leg RDLs. Take three seconds on the way down on the split squats. Make bodyweight feel heavy.
- **Core:** Solid, active plank to wrap it up.

Run it twice a week, 48 hours apart. Take every rep with clean focus. Let me know how the first run feels.

messages.text: For today's session, use that new routine, but skip the core phase - my lower back's a bit tired. Just for today.

paragraphs:
Look, smart call. If the lower back is feeling tired, we don't force loaded holds or flexion onto it. Core phase is pulled for today's session with Travel Full Body.

Warm-up glute bridge stays non-negotiable to fire that right hip, then straight into upper and lower work. Keep your spine neutral on those split squats and don't rush the tempo. Let me know when it's done.

input.message: That's it for today, wrap this up.

output.reply: Good. Rest up, take care of that back, and let's get after it next time.
